name: Bybit linear BTCUSDT historical open interest
description: Bounded poll of GET /v5/market/open-interest with category=linear, symbol=BTCUSDT, intervalTime=5min and limit=1, issued once every 300000 ms. One event per returned list row. open_interest is the provider openInterest string in base (BTC) units, preserved verbatim and never rescaled; event_time is the row's millisecond timestamp, which is the close of the venue's own 5-minute bucket, and retrieved_at is the local receipt time of the bounded body read, so a stale bucket is visible as the gap between them rather than hidden. interval records which venue bucket the row belongs to, because the same identity may be polled at a coarser bucket during a backfill. Rows are deduplicated on event_time: the venue republishes the current bucket until it closes, and a repeat of an already-admitted event_time is a Duplicate notice with no event. A response whose retCode is non-zero, whose result.list is empty, or whose result.symbol is not BTCUSDT is refused; nextPageCursor is read only during an explicit bounded backfill and is never followed during steady-state polling. This is slow context: the live open-interest reading for signals is the bybit.linear.btcusdt.tickers field, and this identity exists to cross-check it and to survive a socket outage. Responses are a bounded rolling window and are never retained beyond it. expected_heartbeat_ms is 900000, three missed 300000 ms polls. Rights-gated: the Bybit row in knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md is unverified and the lane refuses to start unless SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES lists bybit.
